title: The Edge
summary: A largely unplanned journey to Japan’s northernmost point became an early lesson in curiosity and the boundaries we assume.
lens: Curiosity takes us beyond the edges we assume—and reveals possibilities we couldn't see before.

title: The World Before Us
summary: A day at the British Museum revealed how the past gives us context that personal experience alone cannot provide.
lens: Context takes us beyond what we can experience ourselves—and reveals the forces that shaped the world we inherited.

title: The Colours I Never Knew Existed
summary: Coral reefs and unfamiliar shades of blue revealed a world richer than I had ever learned to imagine.
lens: The world is always richer than our imagination.

title: Beyond My Starting Point
summary: A vast coastline opened the possibility that home, identity and the future could extend beyond where life began.
lens: Sometimes a journey doesn't show us where to travel. It shows us where we might belong.

title: Our First Long Journey Together
summary: Our first long family road trip turned exploration into something we could discover and remember together.
lens: Happiness is often sharing a moment, not achieving one.

title: A Volcano Taught Me Gratitude
summary: Carrying my son beneath an ancient volcano became a reflection on time, fatherhood and the value of shared moments.
lens: Time becomes meaningful through moments shared with the people we love.

title: The Windows of a Life
summary: Returning home with my wife and children revealed life's changing seasons—and the opportunities that cannot wait.
lens: Some things in life can wait. Some moments cannot.

title: Design for Options
summary: Travel, career moves and immigration shared one ambition: creating the freedom to choose where to live, work, move—or stay.
lens: Optionality turns constraint into choice—and gives us the freedom to move, stay or choose differently when life changes.
